title: Live: US-Iran to hold third round of talks as Trump deploys warships in Mideast
summary: Iran and the US are holding the third round of indirect talks in Geneva Thursday as President Donald Trump ramps up pressure on Tehran with a massive deployment of military aircraft and warships to the Middle East. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: Oman’s foreign minister said Iranian and US negotiators were exchanging “creative and positive ideas” during talks in Geneva on Thursday. Oman is mediating the indirect talks amid a massive US military buid-up in the Middle East. The two sides took a break following morning negotiations and will resume talks later Thursday, said the Omani foreign minister. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
